title: Marguerite and the House
author: E. M. Nystrom
blurb: Mirabel Montrose, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the harvest moon rises.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
